 Marquette Business to host Graduate School of Management Holiday Party, Dec. 1
 By Alexia Beecher | Marketing and communication specialist in the College of Business Administration
 November 19, 2026 
 < 1 min. read
 Marquette Business will host the Graduate School of Management Holiday Party on Tuesday, Dec. 1, from 4:30 – 6 p.m. in the atrium of Dr. E. J. And Margaret O’Brien Hall. Co-hosted by the Marquette Business Alumni Association, the event will provide a festive setting to celebrate the season and connect with members of the Marquette Business community. 
 This annual event welcomes prospective and current students, alumni, faculty, staff, area professionals and industry partners. Attendees will enjoy a holiday happy hour featuring complimentary beer, soda and heavy appetizers. Afterward, all are encouraged to head to Fiserv Forum for the Marquette Men’s Basketball game vs. Wagner at 6:30 p.m.  
 Registration is required to attend this free event (basketball tickets not included). Learn more and register here.
